label: MikroTik RB260GSP
description: Five-port gigabit switch with passive PoE-out and one SFP cage, in a small indoor case.
notes: Vendor figures from the MikroTik product page specification table: 5x 10/100/1000 Ethernet ports with **PoE-out on Ether2-Ether5** (passive PoE, 1 A per port, 2 A max total), 1x SFP, PoE in Passive PoE on Ether1 (11-30 V). Ether1 is the power input and does not source; four of the five copper ports do.

poe.note: MikroTik publishes current limits only: PoE-out ports Ether2-Ether5, "Passive PoE", low voltage limit 1 A, "Max total out (A) 2 A", with 11-30 V PoE-in on Ether1. No watt figure is printed; 2 A against the input voltage is arithmetic MikroTik did not do, so the budget stays unknown.
